class.name: ResonanceFmodEventEmitter
class.brief_description: Experimental FMOD bridge helper: registers a Steam Audio source for a parent FmodEventEmitter3D. API subject to change.
class.description: Experimental and subject to change. Optional child of [code]FmodEventEmitter3D[/code] when using Nexus Resonance with fmod-gdextension. Add under the FMOD emitter that plays the event. Requires [ResonanceRuntime] with [member ResonanceRuntime.fmod_bridge_enabled] and a loaded [ResonanceFMODBridge] from [method ResonanceRuntime.get_fmod_bridge]. When [member auto_play] is on, creates a Resonance simulation source after ready and syncs [code]global_position[/code] each frame while the source is active. The Steam Audio Simulation Outputs Handle DSP parameter on FMOD events is not wired yet; see project docs FMOD_BRIDGE.md.

members.member: FMOD event path label for this node (informational). Playback is driven by the parent [code]FmodEventEmitter3D[/code]; this node only registers and updates the Steam Audio source.

When true (default), registers the Steam Audio source in play mode after the node is ready, once the FMOD bridge is available. Requires a parent [code]FmodEventEmitter3D[/code] that starts the event (typically its own play call).
